item.title: NVR vs DVR Buying Guide for CCTV Systems in Qatar — Which Recorder Do You Need?
item.description: Choosing between an NVR and DVR for your CCTV system depends on your camera type. This guide explains the difference, how many channels you need, HDD sizing, and what works best for villas and businesses in Qatar.
